title: The Incarnate Logos
english: This man, like God, has overcome death. Again, the soldiers guarded him as dead, but the gatekeepers of Hades, seeing him as God, were terrified. You will say that this is the same one, not another and another, not one in another, nor one through another; for the Logos, who became flesh, has united these things in an ineffable way, giving flesh to passions and using divinity for signs and wonders, as it is not fitting to separate the Logos from the flesh, so it is necessary that sufferings be united with wonders. For the one who, like a dead man, descended into Hades, this one, like God, freed the dead, since angels somehow serve as attendants at the tomb, and the women, like brides, appear to them, and they said to them: 'You seek Jesus...'

title: The Resurrection
english: The Nazarene who was crucified is not here, for he has risen as he said. That is, heaven is his place, send the myrrh there. He has risen, we did not raise him. The stone was rolled away for your sake, the tomb was empty before we came down; he has risen, just as he said.

The angel said that no prophet can explain; Hosea speaks of the time of the resurrection, and Isaiah knew it, but he did not understand how. These are indeed the prophecies of Hosea: 'Let us go and return to the Lord our God, for he has torn us and will heal us; he has struck us down and will bind us up after two days; on the third day, we will rise again and live before him' (Hosea 6:1-2). Listen again to what Isaiah proclaimed: 'The Lebanon has withered, the Sharon has become like a desert...'
